requestBody.query: Preparing devices or accessories for shipping

200.answer: To prepare your device or accessories for shipping, return the device in its original packaging. If the original packaging is unavailable, use a suitable box with proper protection and include all manuals and accessories.

snippets.text: Finish Preparing devices or accessories for shipping Follow these instructions to package and ship your device or accessories. 1 Package Return your device in its original packaging. If you no longer have the original packaging, use another suitable box with proper protection. Include all the manuals and accessories.
snippets.title: How to return your Bell equipment

snippets.text: For online requests: ensure to only use the prepaid shipping label that is emailed to you with the confirmation of your return request. Important: if you have recently purchased a new device, please do not use the shipping label that was included in the box. If your device does not power on, we will require you to provide your device's IMEI number. There are a few ways to find the IMEI: Log in to MyBell and check your original Activation Agreement. In MyBell, go to the Overview Select View my Bell Mobility agreement(s). Open and view the agreement associated with your device. The IMEI is listed under Your Device Details. Look on the original manufacturer's box/packaging that came with your device. If you are unable to find your device's IMEI number, we can assist you in a Bell store or at 1 800 667-0123.
